Specification: S2_transition_without_lagged_M: Mediator transition models omit prior-day treatment; outcome retains full M0-M3 history
S3_cumulative_treatment_outcome: Outcome model summarises M0-M3 as cumulative appropriate-treatment days
S4_ever_treated_outcome: Outcome model summarises M0-M3 as any appropriate treatment
S8_country_without_site: Adjustment includes country but omits nested site indicators
S9_without_centre_indicators: Adjustment omits both site and country indicators
S14_prior_day_severity_for_treatment: Mediator models use prior-day rather than same-day severity
